description: Omzet bulanan (juta rupiah) 3 sales selama 3 bulan. Dipakai buat belajar CTE: pecah analisis jadi langkah-langkah bernama.

samples.label: rata-rata per sales (CTE)
samples.sql: WITH rata AS (SELECT nama, AVG(omzet) AS r FROM sales GROUP BY nama) SELECT * FROM rata ORDER BY r DESC;

samples.label: bulan di atas rata-rata
samples.sql: WITH rata AS (SELECT nama, AVG(omzet) AS r FROM sales GROUP BY nama) SELECT s.nama, s.bulan, s.omzet FROM sales s JOIN rata r ON r.nama = s.nama WHERE s.omzet > r.r;
